_notes: English source strings. All other locale files must mirror these keys.

today.desc_menstrual: Your body is releasing. Rest, warmth, and gentle movement support you best right now.
today.desc_follicular: Energy is building. Your skin is at its brightest, your mind at its sharpest. A good time to plan and create.
today.desc_ovulation: You are at your peak. Confidence is high, skin is glowing, and connection comes naturally.
today.desc_luteal: Slowing down is wisdom. Your body is preparing. Honour what you need and treat yourself gently.
today.desc_unknown: Log your last period to unlock your cycle insights.
today.cta_follicular: Your skin is at its brightest this week. A great time to book a wax or facial treatment.
today.cta_ovulation: Your skin is glowing right now. Make the most of it with a treatment.
today.countdown_days: Your next period is in {count} days
today.countdown_day: Your next period is in {count} day
today.skin_note_menstrual: Skin can be more sensitive and reactive right now. Keep your routine gentle — cleanse, hydrate, and avoid active ingredients like retinol or strong acids.
today.skin_note_follicular: Your skin is clearing and brightening. This is a good time to introduce actives like Vitamin C or light exfoliation.
today.skin_note_ovulation: Skin is at its most radiant. Pores may appear more open — a deep cleanse or facial treatment works beautifully now.
today.skin_note_luteal: Oil production rises and breakouts are more likely. Use a gentle clarifying cleanser and avoid heavy creams.

log.title: tara-s
log.body: She has always known her body. This space is yours to remember.
log.section_period_sub: The first day of your last period.
log.save_hint: Log as many as you like. Tap Save when you're ready.

insights.title: What your body is saying.
insights.subtitle: Patterns drawn from what you have logged.
insights.empty_title: Your patterns will appear here as you log.
insights.need_more_data_title: Keep logging. Your patterns are growing.
insights.need_more_data_body: Log one more cycle and TARA-S will start to see your pattern.
insights.variability_consistent: Your cycles have been very consistent lately.
insights.variability_regular: Your cycles follow a good rhythm. Small variations are completely normal.
insights.variability_irregular: Your cycle length has varied by around {days} days. Your body is responding to your world. Paying attention to patterns over time will tell you more than any single month.

information.title: What we know.
information.subtitle: Research that informs every insight.
information.disclaimer_body: TARA-S is built on thorough research, and we hold that research to a high standard. But every woman's body is beautifully unique. Our aim is simply to offer the best possible experience and to walk alongside you through the natural phases of your cycle.

privacy.title: What we hold, and why.
privacy.subtitle: This is yours. All of it.
privacy.section_collect_body: Your dates. Your symptoms. Nothing else. We have no need for your location, your contacts, or your habits outside this app.
privacy.section_storage_body: Stored securely. Never shared, never sold, never given to anyone, for any reason.
privacy.section_control_body: Take everything with you, or delete it entirely. One tap to download everything. One tap to erase everything, permanently.
privacy.export_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
privacy.delete_confirm: This will permanently erase everything. It cannot be undone. Are you sure?
privacy.delete_modal_body: Once done, it cannot be undone. Every date, every symptom, everything you have shared here will be gone. Are you certain you want to let it all go?
privacy.install_cta: Add TARA-S to your home screen
privacy.install_step1_safari: Tap the three dots (•••) next to the address bar
privacy.install_step2_safari: Tap the Share icon in the menu that opens
privacy.install_step3: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
privacy.install_step1_chrome: Tap the three dots (•••) in the top right

onboarding.welcome_body: Before we begin, a few questions to find your cycle.
onboarding.name_sub: TARA-S will use this to greet you.
onboarding.date_q1: When did your last period start?
onboarding.date_q1_sub: This helps us find where you are in your cycle today.
onboarding.date_q2_sub: Two dates help us find your cycle.
onboarding.date_q3_sub: Three dates and we can begin to see your pattern.
onboarding.ready_sub: TARA-S will learn alongside you. The more you log, the more it understands.
